title: Code Agent Result
description: Structured output from the code agent documenting the target branch, commit message, and PR body for PR creation.

target_branch.description: Branch the PR should target. Determined by the agent from issue context.

commit_message.description: Full commit message including subject line, blank line, and body. The post-script uses the first line as the PR title and the body as fallback PR description.

pr_body.description: PR description used as PR body instead of commit body. Supports markdown formatting and template-compliant structure without gitlint line-length constraints.
